Definition: Cuth or Cuthah, a province of Assyria
BiblicalUsage: Cuth = "crushing"; 1) a place from which king Sargon of Assyria imported colonists into Israel; probably a location approx 20 (32 km) miles northeast of Babylon
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
